phase: Complete-cost known-development query comparison; no new neural heads
cases: ALL15 initial old full-V heads, sorted filename; append fixed original GPT2 EOT=PAD=50256
operation: Joint original-ID JSON EOT PAD* completion plus sampled-token confidence for all free slots; A24 additionally certifies its structural sampling error and common full-posterior top-k commit set
commit_tie_rule: larger confidence first, then smaller physical index; return selected set in canonical physical order
confidence_refinement: Retain original sampled word. Refine numerical confidence and structural upper only, up to full exact CPU if required to certify the common top-k set. Never replace the initial draw-depth TV charge by the later confidence bound.
numeric_cpu: Identical competent exact NumPy binary64 row summaries and block recovery for all CPU methods; same refined original-token partition
numeric_gpu: Both unchanged native Mosaic kernels and independent classical sparse FA with quotient projection. Preserve their floating law explicitly; observe correctness/accuracy, do not claim rational/finite-RNG exactness. Do not charge GPU controls for CPU integer summaries or integer oracle work they do not need.
gpu_environment: Isolated Torch2.13.0+cu130 environment; high float32 matmul precision; fp64 variants supplied. .venv-live remains unchanged.
compilation: EVERY method may compile once per initial canvas and reweight compatible rows. CPU works directly on symbolic graph or direct compact CFG; no compulsory DFA minimization. Native kernels get symbolic-before-expansion Hopcroft minimization. Sparse FA avoids dense E*V, N*E and N*N buffers. No solver source is modified to worsen controls.
rotation: Rotate candidate/control order per repetition; no concurrent tests, installs or other research workloads during timings
timers: Separate one-time tokenizer/lexer/class/kernel setup, per-initial-frame compile/minimize/device buffers, and warm full query. Warm query includes fresh numeric conversion/sums or GPU copies, all inference/certificate/refinement, original-ID sample recovery, requested confidence and returned commit set. All CUDA stages synchronize. Input disk replay/hash and independent exact oracle validation are outside ALL operational timers, reported separately.
model_scope: This is an OLD-head operation replay. Report raw measured times and a separately labeled projection adding the original archived forward+softmax wall/CPU; never call that a new forward or a complete fresh trajectory. Later full-generation work requires its own frozen protocol.
primary_gate: For a candidate/state require <=0.8 paired median projected warm wall AND CPU versus EVERY completed mandatory method/configuration, with favorable sign in every paired repetition, no candidate errors/refusals, all samples valid/fixed IDs preserved and numerical/confidence checks passed. Need >=3/15 states before any fresh-head confirmation is considered. Select candidate by state count, then predeclared handoff-before-closed tie. Zero or <3 rejects this development gate; do not relax it after measuring.
refusal_scope: A refused control is retained and not credited as a timing win; separately report capability under stated resources and strict timing wins with ALL controls completed. Conservative estimated allocation guards are not measured OOM or lower bounds for all CFG/FA inference. Sparse/compact controls remain obligatory.
secondary: Report cold setup-plus-first-query and each stage without promoting an isolated cold advantage to the primary warm gate. No favorable-case removal or threshold changes.
correctness: Independent strict JSON of content before first EOT, PAD-only suffix, all initial fixed original IDs preserved. Exact CPU methods agree with full mass where conclusive. Native/sparse sampled-ID confidences checked against integer full/shallow posteriors outside timers on same head/canvas; tolerance0.005 fp32/1e-8 fp64, all numerical failures retained. A24 ranking decisions must agree with exact full-target map where full control concludes; preserve unresolved/refused cases.
fresh_branch: Only a positive complete primary gate permits a new independent external-corpus application protocol and fresh model forwards. Distinctive originality/significance of the specific A24 certificate/application must also be defended; correct controls or a development speedup alone do not complete the user goal. No publication/admission guarantee.
input_device: Common full physical binary64 probability matrix is resident on CUDA before EVERY operational timer, with singleton rows for initially fixed IDs. GPU controls consume it directly; CPU methods pay free-row device-to-host transfer. Native samplers pay conversion to log weights/configured dtype. No control pays CPU integer oracle work.
output_device: Original word, sampled confidence vector and commit mask on CUDA for EVERY method, as consumed by a diffusion loop. CPU methods pay transfer of their results. Independent CPU conversion/recognition/oracles are outside all query timers. Timers synchronize CUDA before and after.
candidate_flow: Both candidate variants use the cheap grammar-hit certificate first. If insufficient, handoff_cpu continues by grammar-prefix handoff, closed_cpu uses min(grammar-hit,closed-counter). Grammar_hit_cpu uses grammar-hit alone; suffix_hit_cpu uses its lexical necessary-suffix certificate. All retain true terminated shallow mass as denominator.
negative_only_futility: First run ALL15 states and ALL3 rotations for both candidates against exact_stack_cpu,sparse_fa_fp32,sparse_fa_fp64, with rotated order within this subset. Each state failing the same <=0.8 median and all-sign rule against ANY completed control is irreversibly rejected for that candidate. If fewer than3 states remain possible for BOTH candidates, stop and preserve this mathematically sufficient NEGATIVE audit without running the other controls. No positive finding or fresh campaign may be based on partial rows. Otherwise execute ALL remaining mandatory methods/configurations on ALL15 states/rotations before any primary decision.
